cases.title: Baseline: a live record is returned by read
A tombstone is not returned by read: the same id that read a record now reads nothing
Baseline: search returns both records before either is deleted
A tombstone is excluded from search while its live sibling is still returned
Deleting a tombstone is refused rather than silently succeeding a second time
A delete leaves a tombstone in storage rather than erasing the record
Baseline: every order projects a row while its joined customer is live
Deleting a joined source record drops the whole row, not merely the joined fields
The order whose row vanished is itself untouched and still carries the deleted customer's id
Deleting the primary source record removes its row from the read model
Baseline: a membership record grants the context role an all-mode read model resolves from
Deleting the membership record revokes the context role and the scoped rows with it
Deleting the context object leaves the available set even though the membership record survives
Baseline: an offline dataset carries the record before it is deleted
An offline dataset excludes a tombstoned record while keeping its live sibling
Baseline: a membership record puts its band, itself and its scoped gig in the offline dataset
Deleting the membership record empties the dataset's context roles and its context-scoped records
Deleting the context object empties the available set while the surviving membership row stays unscoped
